name: What should I ask a room addition contractor before hiring them?

mainEntity.name: What should I ask a room addition contractor before hiring them in Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: What should I ask a room addition contractor before hiring them in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: A room addition contractor should be able to explain the project clearly before a contract is signed. Good questions include how many similar additions they have completed locally, who handles permits and inspections, whether structural engineering is included, and what the payment schedule looks like. Homeowners should also ask what is excluded from the bid, how change orders are priced, how dust and site protection will be handled, and what happens if hidden issues are found after demolition. It is also worth asking how the contractor communicates during construction and whether they use the same subcontractors throughout the project. The best contractor is not always the lowest price. The best value is the one that gives a clear scope, realistic schedule, and specific process for managing surprises. That is especially important in Los Angeles, where permit complexity and older homes can quickly affect both cost and timing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about similar local projects, permit experience, structural work, timeline, payment schedule, change-order process, and what is included in the bid. The best contractor should explain how they handle plans, inspections, site protection, and cost overruns before work begins.
